newsitem.title: USA: Uni-Marts Q1 hurt by weak gasoline margins.
newsitem.headline: Uni-Marts Q1 hurt by weak gasoline margins.

text.p: Uni-Marts Inc Thursday said first quarter 1997 results were hurt by weak October and November 1996 gasoline margins, which were more than 3 cents per gallon lower than the same months in the prior year.

The company noted, however, that gasoline gasoline margins began a return to historical levels in late December 1996. First quarter earnings were also reduced by higher labor costs resulting from the minimum wage increase, staffing for prepared food installations and additional depreciation and interest expenses resulting from the firm's accelerated capital expenditure program.
The firm said net earnings for the 1997 first fiscal quarter were $49,655, or $0.01 per share, compared to net earnings of $1,398,228, or $0.22 per share, for the first quarter of fiscal 1996.
